title: 0239 - THE SUPPORT GAME IS EXACT AT EVERY SMALL SIEVE: mod 5 and mod 7 forbid one row-wise residue class of L_next (the class making p'' = p + L + L_next + 2 = 0 mod q) - measured 0 violations over 5,011,556 gaps (L = 3..11 x all p mod q classes, q in {5, 7}), joining mod 3's 0 hits / 3,776,589 (0238). The full support hierarchy: mod 2 (parity, trivial) -> mod 3 (the one-bit carrier, +0.1667 nats/step) -> mod 5, 7, ... (exact, thinner). No RH claim
body: 0239 extends the 0238 support theorem to the next sieves. Statement (q a small prime, q < p''): for primes p < p' < p'' with L = p'-p-1 and L_next = p''-p'-1, the row (L mod q, p mod q) forbids exactly ONE residue class of L_next mod q - the class for which p'' = p + L + L_next + 2 = 0 (mod q) (for primes p, the p mod q = 0 class is absent when p != q). Measurement at X = 1e8, XLO = 1e5 (same census as 0236-0238; q in {5, 7}, L in {3, 5, 7, 9, 11}, all p mod q classes with >= 5,000 gaps): 0 violations over 5,011,556 gaps - every row's forbidden class is exactly vacant, including the displayed q = 5 sample rows (L=3,p=2: n=146,539, forb=3, 0; L=5,p=1: n=264,944, forb=2, 0; L=5,p=2: n=237,150, forb=1, 0; L=7,p=1: n=95,819, forb=0, 0; L=9,p=1: n=118,604, forb=3, 0; L=9,p=2: n=95,504, forb=2, 0; L=11,p=1: n=172,692, forb=1, 0; L=11,p=2: n=173,224, forb=0, 0) plus all q = 7 rows. Structure: the support constraints form a strict hierarchy by sieve weight - mod 2 (parity of L_next, trivial: L_next is always odd), mod 3 (the one-bit OT/TW carrier of 0238: +0.16667 nats/step, 79.8% of the 0237 exact-value gain, z = +92856), and mod 5, 7, 11, ... (exact but each forbidding only 1 of q classes, so individually thinner). The COARSE pair-family table P(L_next | L) violates ALL of these supports simultaneously (it mixes the p mod q families), which is why conditioning on residue information beats it; the marginal NLL gains beyond the mod-3 bit (the +0.0421 fine-spf part, 0238) are the mod 5, 7, ... supports plus genuine density modulation on the supported bins. The general statement is a one-line theorem family (p'' prime => p'' != 0 (mod q)); the mod-3 instance is already in-tree (formal/RhAttack/LoomWheel.lean, 0238); the mod-5/7 generalization is a pending Lean item (Q1'''a). Off-board side-quest. No RH claim (elementary modular arithmetic, stated as such).
